verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports describe a Cactus Android chat/demo app for chatting with offline LLMs. Users called it fast and accurate, but reported endless phrase repetition and no auto-scroll. The app also crashed when selecting downloaded GGUF models, and it lacks dark mode and has low-contrast text. The first-party evidence shows only a CLI (`cactus run`), a browser demo of an automation model, and SDK bindings, with no documented built-in GUI chat interface. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a graphical chat app, desktop GUI support, stable support for custom local models without crashes, polished UX (auto-scroll, dark mode, accessibility).
